# Getting Help

Thanks for using AIWork! Here's where to go depending on what you need.

## Questions & discussion

Have a usage question, an idea to talk through, or want to share what you're building?
Head to [**GitHub Discussions**](https://github.com/debpalash/agentwork/discussions).
It's the best place for open-ended help with the SDK, CLI, MCP server, agent-runner,
or running the stack locally.

## Bugs & feature requests

Found something broken or want to propose a change? Open an issue using the forms:

- [**Bug report**](https://github.com/debpalash/agentwork/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) — for defects and unexpected behavior
- [**Feature request**](https://github.com/debpalash/agentwork/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) — for new capabilities and improvements

Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/debpalash/agentwork/issues) first to
avoid duplicates.

## Security vulnerabilities

**Do not file security issues publicly.** AIWork handles on-chain escrow and runs
untrusted code in sandboxes, so please report vulnerabilities privately by following
our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).

---

We're a small project and read everything that comes in. Clear, reproducible reports
help us help you faster. Thanks for contributing!
